key_highlights: ASX 200 shakes off early weakness to creep higher despite substantial volatility across global equity markets.
ANZ posts robust $7.6b full-year profit, but warns of mounting home loan repayment delinquencies under tight monetary settings.
Australia's housing market enters its steepest recorded downturn as aggressive RBA policy impacts mortgagors.
AUD/USD experiences sharp devaluation, placing pressure on imported inflation while boosting export competitiveness.
Resource activity stays dynamic with high-grade gold upgrades in WA and critical exploration milestones in Beetaloo gas.

sectors.trend: Earnings resilience tested by deteriorating credit metrics and rising residential mortgage stress.
sectors.implications: Strong headline cash earnings at ANZ.AX underpin near-term dividend safety, but rising 90+ day arrears foreshadow escalating bad-debt provisioning across major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX).

sectors.trend: Subdued bulk commodity demand contrasting with exploratory momentum in gold and critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Iron ore heavyweights (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) remain capped by uncertain Chinese industrial demand, while junior and mid-tier gold developers (FRS.AX, DAL.AX) benefit from safe-haven asset demand.

sectors.trend: Depressed crude pricing offset by long-term domestic and regional gas development approvals.
sectors.implications: Soft global oil benchmarks constrain cash flows for majors (WDS.AX, STO.AX), whereas major progress in the Beetaloo Basin reinforces future long-term domestic gas supply.

sectors.trend: Severe residential property correction alongside structural tenant challenges for retail mall landlords.
sectors.implications: Sharp declines in home values pressure residential developers, while department store turnover uncertainty (David Jones) elevates lease renewal risks for retail REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX).

sectors.trend: Data centre growth facing heightened community pushback, grid bottlenecks, and calls for moratoriums.
sectors.implications: Grid capacity limitations and planning scrutiny pose delivery timetable and capex hurdles for hyperscale data centre operators and real estate backers (NXT.AX, GMG.AX).

key_themes: Monetary policy transmission straining household cash flows and accelerating mortgage delinquency rates.
Sharp AUD/USD weakness creating divergence between import-exposed cyclicals and offshore dollar earners.
Infrastructure capacity constraints impacting high-growth digital infrastructure projects.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LVR regional lenders and non-bank mortgage providers; prioritize well-capitalised Big Four banks with substantial provisioning buffers.
Overweight unhedged US-dollar revenue earners (CSL.AX, BHP.AX) to hedge local currency devaluation while avoiding import-reliant domestic retail.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Power Grid Delays & Moratoriums on Data Centres
risk_assessment.mitigation: Focus on infrastructure developers with fully permitted power allocations and secured grid interconnect agreements.
Rotate bulk mining allocations toward low-cost tier-one producers and hedge with defensive exposure to precious metals.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight offshore revenue generators and healthcare defensives
opportunities.rationale: Depreciating Australian dollar delivers strong currency translation benefits to globally diversified companies with steady pricing power.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on resource expansions in gold and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: High-grade resource upgrades and global market dislocation support margin expansion for established gold producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate strategic long-term domestic gas developers
opportunities.rationale: Secured production and exploration licences in the Beetaloo Basin position key operators to resolve structural East Coast gas deficits.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail REITs and cyclical consumer discretionary names
defensive_moves.rationale: Intensifying household budget pressure and department store anchor vulnerability threaten foot traffic and occupancy rates.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad market exposure against bank credit quality deterioration
defensive_moves.rationale: Late-stage credit deterioration and record residential real estate declines will constrain major bank multiples and cap ASX 200 upside.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound and volatile. The ASX 200 (^AXJO) will navigate international market spillovers and consumer weakness, supported primarily by banking dividend yield floors.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued trajectory pending clear evidence of RBA monetary policy easing and property market stabilisation. Clear divergence expected between global USD earners and rate-sensitive domestic equities.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statements and official cash rate decisions
Banking sector 90+ day mortgage delinquency and impairment reporting
Chinese industrial policy updates and stimulus impact on iron ore pricing
Regulatory approvals and power allocation policies for national data centre hubs
watch_list: ANZ.AX, CBA.AX, and WBC.AX residential mortgage arrear metrics
Singapore and Dalian iron ore futures benchmarks
